title: Public Env Guard
description: Stops secrets shipping in the client bundle by reading a .env the way the bundler does, listing every NEXT_PUBLIC_, VITE_, REACT_APP_, EXPO_PUBLIC_ or PUBLIC_ variable that reaches the browser, flagging secret key shapes, Supabase service_role JWTs, passwords in URLs, secret names and high-entropy values (while letting publishable keys through), and renaming a key to server-only in one tap with a reminder to rotate it.
stops: Secret key shipped in the bundle
